ControllerUpdate.name: Read joypads, update input bytes
summary: Reads both joypads from the auto-read registers $4218-$421B and keeps held and newly pressed bits for each in $0DA2-$0DAD.
Then copies one pad's bits to the input bytes: [$15] held byetUDLR, [$16] pressed byetUDLR, [$17] held AXLR, [$18] pressed AXLR.
A and B (and X and Y) are merged into bits 7 and 6 of [$15] and [$16]. The pad is [$0DA0] if non-negative, else the current player [$0DB3].
$0086C7 (separate routine, called at $009A67): sets the size bytes of sprites 0-99 ($0420-$0483) to $02 and hides sprites 100-127.

ExecutePtr.name: JSL trampoline: 16-bit pointer table
summary: Jumps to the A-th 16-bit pointer of the table that follows the JSL. Never returns to the caller; the target returns instead.
Parameters: A: table index. 8-bit A, X, Y. Destroys [$00]-[$03]; Y is preserved.

ExecutePtrLong.name: Long pointer trampoline and VRAM uploaders
summary: $0086FA: ExecutePtrLong, like ExecutePtr but with 24-bit table entries (A * 3). Destroys [$00]-[$05].
$00871E (JSR): uploads a stripe image to VRAM with DMA channel 1. Parameters: [$00]-[$01] address and A = bank of the image.
Records: VRAM address high, low, then a word (bit 7 vertical, bit 6 RLE, low 14 bits = byte count - 1), then the data; ends at a first byte with bit 7 set.
RLE records repeat 2 bytes (tile, properties) in two DMA passes. Quirk: pass 2 uses a 2-register DMA mode from $2119, so it probably also writes $211A.
$0087AD (JSL): uploads the layer 1 buffer ([$1BE4]/[$1BE5] = VRAM address, data at $1BE6-$1CE5) and layer 2 buffer ([$1CE6]/[$1CE7], $1CE8-$1DE7).
Horizontal layers get 2 tile columns (each in 2 DMAs across the two vertical screens), vertical layers 2 tile rows. Clears the flags [$1BE4], [$1CE6].

s008A16.name: Table: DMA setups for tilemap updates
summary: Eight 7-byte DMA channel 1 setups (DMAP 1, B-bus $18, source $00:xxxx, size) copied by the routine at $0087AD.

ClearStack.name: Clear RAM except the stack page
summary: Clears $0000-$00FF and $0200-$1FFF (the stack page $0100-$01FF is skipped, despite the label), empties the stripe image buffer at $7F:837B/837D
and clears [$0681]. Called at reset and from the game mode loaders.

SetUpScreen.name: Reset PPU layer addresses and effects
summary: Resets SETINI and mosaic, sets the BG1/BG2/BG3 tilemap sizes and addresses and the chr bases, clears the window masks and logic (and their RAM mirrors
[$41]-[$43]), sets the color math mirror [$44] = $02 and the Mode 7 screen-over mode.

s008AB4.name: Table: sine index adjustments
summary: Used by the Mode 7 matrix routine: indexed by quadrant * 2. The EOR/addend pair turns an in-quadrant offset into $100 - offset in odd quadrants.

s008ACD.name: Calculate Mode 7 rotation matrix
summary: Builds the Mode 7 matrix from the rotation angle [$36] and the scales [$38] and [$39]: A [$2E] = cos * [$38], B [$30] = sin * [$38],
C [$32] = -sin * [$39], D [$34] = cos * [$39]. Values are 8.8 fixed point (a scale of $20 gives $0100). Called by the Mode 7 boss room code.
$008AE8: computes [$30] and [$2E] for scale [$00]. $008B2B: A = (sine table entry X * [$00]) / 32 using the hardware multiplier.

s008B57.name: Table: sine values, then unused tilemap words
summary: 129 little-endian words: sin(0..90 degrees) * $100, ending at $0100. The 20 tilemap words after it ($8C59-$8C80) are not referenced by anything
I found. The last 8 bytes are the item box top row used by GM04DoDMA.

s008C89.name: Table: initial status bar tilemap
summary: Tile/property words for the BG3 status bar: line 1 (28 words), line 2 (27 words) and the item box bottom row (4 words). Uploaded by GM04DoDMA,
which also copies the tile numbers to the RAM mirror at $0EF9.

GM04DoDMA.name: Upload initial status bar to VRAM
summary: Writes the item box top, status bar lines 1 and 2 and the item box bottom into the BG3 tilemap with DMA channel 1, copies the 55 tile numbers to the
mirror at $0EF9 (used by DrawStatusBar) and sets the timer frame countdown [$0F30] = $28.

s008D90.name: Table: DMA setups for status bar init
summary: Four 7-byte DMA channel 1 setups (DMAP 1, B-bus $18) used by GM04DoDMA.

DrawStatusBar.name: Upload status bar tile numbers
summary: DMAs the tile number mirrors $0EF9 (28 bytes) and $0F15 (27 bytes) to the low bytes of the BG3 tilemap at $5042 and $5063.
Called every NMI. The properties are set once by GM04DoDMA.

DMAdata_StBr1.name: Table: DMA setup, status bar line 1
summary: 7 bytes for DrawStatusBar: DMAP 0, B-bus $18, source $00:0EF9, $001C bytes.
